summary: Eau Claire County, WI tower in the Conservation Department's District 10, complete by May 13, 1932; listed gone, with a Marathon County tower labelled as its relocation.

facts.status_note: Original Eau Claire County site listed as gone; a Marathon County tower labelled as the relocated Wilson is listed as standing, location not published

events.note: Listed among towers already completed in a newspaper item dated May 13, 1932 (The Post-Crescent, as quoted on the lookout page); the build year itself is not given

evidence.supports: tower located in Eau Claire County
Wilson listed among towers already completed, May 13, 1932
evidence.quote: The towers already completed are: Wilson in district 10.

evidence.supports: original Eau Claire County tower listed as gone
relocated Wilson tower in Marathon County, listed as standing, location given as Private
the Block entry sits under a separate section headed Relocated / Replica Lookouts

notes_for_editor: Relocation date, mover and destination are not in the sources read, so no relocation event is recorded and the Marathon County entry is not mapped (the FFLA row gives no coordinates). The 1932 build year is inferred from 'already completed' in a May 13, 1932 item and reads as by that date. A WI Historical Society Facebook post surfaced in search describing a 1932 Aeromotor tower moved by the CCC in 1935; the page returned a login wall, so it is not cited. If it can be read and clearly concerns the Wilson tower, it would give the move date and should be added. The Post-Crescent quote is taken from the lookout page; the newspaper itself was not read.
